Package Slots.WinInfo

Class WinInfo

java.lang.Object
Slots.WinInfo.WinInfo
public class WinInfo extends Object
Represents information about a win in a slot machine game. Stores details such as the game type, win type, winning symbol, and either the number of matching symbols (for one-dimensional slots) or the winning fields (for two-dimensional slots).
